Role - Intern/Junior Java Backend Developer – AI-Enabled Development
Location: Oakland, CA - Onsite 
Candidate 
Job Description

- We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Intern Java Backend Developer with a foundational understanding of Java programming, backend technologies, and emerging AI-assisted software development tools.
- This opportunity is ideal for recent graduates, final-year students, or early-career professionals looking to gain hands-on experience in backend application development and modern software engineering practices.
- Candidates should have a basic understanding of Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, SQL databases, and object-oriented programming. They should also demonstrate practical exposure to AI through college projects, internships, personal projects, or self-learning initiatives.
- The ideal candidate will be eager to learn, collaborate with experienced developers, and contribute to real-world software development projects while exploring AI-powered development tools and cloud-native technologies.


Key Responsibilities

- Assist in developing, maintaining, and enhancing backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
- Support the development and integration of REST APIs for application functionality and system integrations.
- Write basic SQL queries and assist with database-related development and troubleshooting.
- Learn and contribute to implementing business rules using rules engines such as Drools or Kogito.
- Write clean, readable, maintainable, and testable code under the guidance of senior developers.
- Assist in writing and executing unit tests using JUnit and Mockito.
- Work with Linux environments, command-line tools, and basic shell scripting.
- Use GitHub for source control, repository management, and collaborative development.
- Gain exposure to containerized applications and Kubernetes.
- Learn and work with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure.
- Explore AI-assisted development tools to improve coding productivity, testing, debugging, and development workflows.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to troubleshoot technical issues and deliver reliable software solutions.


Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or currently pursuing a relevant degree.
- Basic knowledge of Java programming and object-oriented programming concepts.
Foundational understanding of:

- Java and object-oriented programming.
- Spring Boot and REST APIs.
- Basic microservices concepts.
- JPA/Hibernate and API integration.
- Maven or Gradle.
- JUnit and Mockito.
- Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases, including queries, joins, and database design.
- Familiarity with C/C++ programming fundamentals.
- Basic knowledge of Linux environments, command-line tools, and shell scripting.
- Familiarity with GitHub and basic repository management.
- Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts.
- Demonstrated interest in AI and AI-assisted software development through academic projects, internships, personal projects, or hands-on learning.


Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to AI-assisted software development tools such as:
- Claude Code.
- OpenAI Codex.
- GitHub Copilot.
- Academic or personal projects demonstrating the use of AI tools to generate or review code, automate tasks, improve testing, or troubleshoot technical issues.
- Basic familiarity with business rules engines such as Drools or Kogito.
- Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized applications.
- Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
- Interest in the dental or medical insurance industry, particularly insurance claims processing.
- Candidates located in or near Oakland or San Francisco, California, are preferred.


Required AI Project Exposure
Candidates should be prepared to discuss at least one college, internship, or personal project involving AI or AI-assisted software development.
Examples of relevant experience include:
Using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot to assist with application development.
Using AI tools to generate unit tests, debug code, or identify potential defects.
Integrating AI capabilities into a Java or Spring Boot application.
Using AI to automate repetitive development tasks or improve project workflows.
Exploring AI tools as part of academic assignments, coding exercises, or personal projects.
Candidates should be able to explain:
The objective of the project.
The technologies and tools used.
How AI was used in the project.
Their individual contribution.
The practical benefits achieved, such as improved development efficiency, reduced manual effort, better testing, or easier troubleshooting.
Specific numerical improvements are welcome when supported by actual project results.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Willingness to learn new technologies and development practices.
Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross-functional teams.
Curiosity about AI, automation, and modern software development tools.
Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and seek guidance when needed.
Positive attitude, adaptability, and eagerness to gain hands-on industry experience.

Position Title

Intern, Technology, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering & Platform Operations

Your role at Sephora... 

The DevOps, SRE & Platform Operations Intern will join a high-impact engineering team focused on improving system reliability, reducing operational toil, increasing automation, and strengthening engineering productivity.

This internship provides hands-on experience in modern cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, SRE practices, observability, operational analytics, platform engineering, and infrastructure automation.

The intern will work closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and DevEx teams on a project that delivers measurable operational improvements and business value.

What You Will Accomplish



-  Analyze operational workflows, infrastructure and platform metrics, and service health signals to identify automation and reliability improvement opportunities.
-  Develop and test scripts, tools, dashboards, or workflows that reduce manual effort and improve operational visibility in a controlled environment.
-  Contribute to monitoring, observability, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, database operations, or developer self-service initiatives based on the selected project scope.
-  Document the solution through architecture guidance, operational processes, runbooks, test evidence, and a knowledge-transfer package that enables future use and extension.
-  Present the business problem, technical approach, results, operational impact, lessons learned, and recommended next steps to engineering and leadership audiences.
-  Demonstrate our Sephora values: Passion, Innovation, Expertise, Balance, Respect, Teamwork, and Initiative.

Qualifications & Experience



-  Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
-  Experience with at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, or Bash.
-  Foundational understanding of Linux, networking, APIs, Git source control, and cloud computing concepts.
-  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and translate a broad problem into a practical project plan.
-  Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and explain outcomes to technical and leadership audiences.
-  Exposure through coursework, projects, or internships to cloud platforms, containers, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, platform engineering, reliability engineering, or distributed systems.
- Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS 
- Docker and Kubernetes

Job Overview 
 We are looking for Quantitative Developer Interns to join our Research team. We are a collaborative, data-driven, intellectually rigorous group responsible for proposing investment ideas, codifying these ideas into signals, and back-testing these signals to produce return, risk and trading cost forecasts to drive trading decisions. We work in a friendly environment and place a high value on learning, innovation, attitude and initiative.

 Our Quantitative Developers are responsible for delivering impact projects using cloud technologies, AI, distributed and high-performance compute, numeric computation, data visualization and APIs to solve complex problems in finance and research.

 As a Quantitative Developer Intern, you will be immersed in our research efforts, working closely with Quant Researcher and Quant Developers to enhance our investment strategies. Our internship program combines theory and practice, providing experience delivering real-world projects in quantitative finance and technology.

 Responsibilities 
 Typical responsibilities include:
 
• Solving complex quantitative problems with Python or R 
• Designing and developing tools or libraries to enhance our data science technology stack 
• Performing exploratory data analysis across large complex data sets to inform investment and signal ideas 
• Implementing performance improvements in our data analysis and numerical programming libraries 
• Running POCs to evaluate technologies and libraries in cloud and PyData ecosystems 
 Qualifications 
 
• Enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program from an educational institution in a technical field, such as computer science or engineering, with an additional focus in data science, applied mathematics, economics. Expected degree completion within a year of the internship 
• Strong analytical, quantitative, programming and problems solving skills 
• Knowledge of software design paradigms, data structures, and numerical algorithms 
• Understanding of probability and statistics, including linear regression and time-series analysis 
• Experience with distributed computing, natural language processing, AI / machine learning, library development, system design, numeric processing or data visualization 
• Creativity and enthusiasm leveraging technologies including AI to enhance productivity, automate processes and improve technical quality 
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills 
• Interest in financial markets (prior experience not required) 
 The weekly wage range for this position is $3,500 - $5,000 per week.
 
 Arrowstreet Capital operates a robust talent acquisition program, and we also seek to compensate and reward our employees competitively within our industry and in line with our merit-based culture. The determination of a successful candidate’s base wage placement within the listed range will vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications (which may also include relevant certifications, credentials and other education), the job responsibilities and scope, the commensurate resulting level of the position and other relevant factors. The listed range is also an estimate, and additional information regarding base wages and other elements of total compensation offered by Arrowstreet Capital to successful applicants will be communicated during the recruitment process. 
 
 Arrowstreet Capital is a Boston-based systematic investment firm that manages global equity portfolios for institutional investors around the world. 
 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, genetic information, age, pregnancy, medical condition, disability, veteran or military status, marital status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.
 
 Arrowstreet Capital is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process due to a disability, contact us to discuss the nature of your request and contact information.
